# fnug-vt100

A fork of [vt100](https://github.com/doy/vt100-rust) 0.15
(`1e4014aa72a7552d2f69b81ad89d56e035354041`), maintained for
[fnug](https://github.com/nickolaj-jepsen/fnug). It keeps the 0.15 API and
adds scrollback fixes, a full-buffer text accessor, dim and strikethrough,
`REP`, and replies to cursor position and device attribute queries. See
`CHANGELOG.md` for details.

It is not API-compatible with upstream vt100 0.16.
